About CebSpot
CebSpot
Discover Cebu. Find your next spot.
CebSpot is a mobile application for discovery and leisure in Cebu City. It helps users explore local places, learn more about venues, and plan their next visit.
Technical Documentation
Explore CebSpot’s features and system architecture.
Privacy Policy
Understand how your information is handled.
Our purpose and story
We created CebSpot to bring local discovery tools and venue information together, helping users make informed choices about where to go while supporting the visibility of local establishments.
CebSpot was developed as a capstone project by Bachelor of Science in Information Technology students at the University of Southern Philippines Foundation.
Rooted in Cebu City
CebSpot focuses on Cebu City, with listed places across categories such as cafés, restaurants, outdoor spots, street food, co-working spaces, bars, and clubs. Listings are a selection of places, rather than a complete directory of every establishment.
Table reservations are available only at participating establishments, subject to table and schedule availability and each venue’s booking policies.
How CebSpot works
01
Find your next spot
Search Explore and filter places by category, distance, and rating. Browse map pins and open a place to learn more.
02
Get to know a venue
View available photos, venue details, and community reviews. Save spots to revisit from your Profile.
03
Share local discoveries
Use Share a Spot to submit a place for review. On a spot’s page, write a review, add photos, or suggest corrected details.
04
Plan a table reservation

Welcome to CebSpot (“the Platform”, “we”, “our”, or “us”). We are committed to protecting your privacy and handling your information responsibly. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices available to you when using our website and mobile application.
By accessing or using CebSpot, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

Technical Documentation
TECHNICAL DOCS
CebSpot
System overview, features, architecture layers, and technical specifications of the mobile application for discovery and leisure in Cebu City.
OVERVIEW
FEATURES
ARCHITECTURE
SYSTEM OVERVIEW
Platform Summary
CebSpot is a mobile application designed to support discovery and leisure in Cebu City. It brings together published local spot information, map-based exploration, community contributions, and reservation features where available. The application helps users explore places and plan visits, while participating establishments manage supported reservation activities through the owner interface.
The directory depends on published venue records and reviewed contributions. Not every place offers reservations, complete opening information, or the same payment options. The application presents the information and controls available for the selected spot rather than treating every listing as a bookable venue.
For explorers
Use your account to browse and search, filter results, open venue details and galleries, read or write reviews, and save places on your device. You can suggest corrections or submit a new spot for review. At a participating venue, choose an available schedule and table, provide guest details, and follow the booking’s confirmation or payment steps.
For venue owners
Approved owners use the role-based dashboard or web owner portal to manage assigned venues. Their workflows include venue details and gallery updates, table schedules, guest reservations, manual payment review where offered, arrival status, and review replies. Administrators separately review place submissions, corrections, and owner-access requests.
